items:
Nestled in Inlet Beach, this fabulous house boasts 4 cozy bedrooms - one with a king bed, two with queen beds, and one with a twin bed. With 3 sparkling bathrooms featuring showers and hair dryers, guests will feel right at home. Enjoy the convenience of amenities like heating, AC, a washing machine, and WiFi. It's easy to see why you'll be able to unwind at our place.

Welcome to your home away from home.



Discover Comfort, Convenience, and Coastal Charm at Our Upscale Inlet Beach Home!

Your Ideal Vacation Spot: Nestled in the prestigious Inlet Beach community, our rental home offers unparalleled comfort and convenience.

Prime Location: Just a quick 4-minute bike ride to the pristine shores of Inlet Beach Regional Access. Enjoy a day at the expansive beach with parking, restrooms, and ramp access to the sand. Perfect for setting up a beach bonfire picnic with our exclusive concierge service.

Shop & Dine: A short 3-minute bike ride takes you to the stunning 30Avenue shopping district. Explore incredible dining and shopping options, plus enjoy outdoor entertainment during high season.

Daily Delight: Don’t miss Daily Happy Hour at Amici 30A, renowned for the best happy hour in the area!

Book your stay now and experience the best of Inlet Beach living!



Step into Comfort and Style in Our Inlet Beach Retreat

Inviting Atmosphere: Experience an inviting atmosphere with stylish furnishings and ample natural light filtering through large windows, creating a warm and welcoming space.

Open-Concept Layout: The open-concept layout seamlessly blends the living, dining, and kitchen areas, providing a spacious and airy environment perfect for relaxation and entertainment.

Luxurious Bedrooms: Retreat to beautifully appointed bedrooms, each offering plush bedding and a tranquil ambiance, ensuring a restful night's sleep after a day of beachside adventures.



Exciting Activities to Enjoy During Your Stay

Lake Powell and Camp Helen State Park: Discover the beauty of Lake Powell, one of the largest coastal dune lakes in Florida. Rent kayaks or YOLO boards for a once-in-a-lifetime adventure on a freshwater-fed lake that flows directly into the Gulf. Explore the serene surroundings of Camp Helen State Park with its pristine beaches and nature trails.

Inlet Beach: Soak up the sun and enjoy the stunning shoreline of Inlet Beach. Relax on the white sandy beaches, swim in the clear blue waters, or take a leisurely stroll along the coast.

Dinner at the Beach: End your day with a delightful dinner at one of the beachside restaurants. Savor fresh seafood and enjoy the beautiful sunset views, creating the perfect ending to your beachside getaway.



Sandpine Loop Oasis features:

- Across from the community pool, with lounge seating plus umbrellas.
- 4-minute drive to Inlet Beach ADA Regional Beach Access with parking, ramp access to sand, rest rooms, beach service, and Grouper Reef - one of only 4 man-made reefs in Walton County.
- Less than 2 miles to Camp Helen and Lake Powell. Rent kayaks or YOLO boards to explore this rare freshwater fed lake which flows directly into the Gulf
- 7-Minute bike ride to Rosemary Beach with famous architecture plus shopping and dining. Easy access crossing Hwy 98 thanks to the new pedestrian underpass at Hwy 30A and Hwy 98.
- Driveway parking for 2 vehicles. RV, Trailer, and street parking prohibited
- A living room on each floor

- Fully kitchen including all things necessary to cook full meals
- 1st Floor Queen Suite is ideal for the grandparents to join in on the family fun
- Cable and wifi
- Dining area with seating for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 3
- Laundry room with washer and dryer
- Covered patio with cushioned outdoor seating set and propane grill
- Outdoor shower
- Keyless entry for easy access to the home while staying secure at all times
- Flexible arrival days year-round with less than 7 night reservations available
- Concierge services including grocery delivery, beach service, baby equipment rentals, and more available
- We do not recommend golf cart rentals as they are prohibited from driving on Highway 98

=====================================================================

4 Bedrooms, 3 Full Baths, Sleeps 8
- 1st Floor Queen Guest Room adjacent to Full Bath
- 2nd Floor King Suite
- 2nd Floor Queen Guest Room adjacent to Full Bath
- 2nd Floor Guest room with sleeping for 2 in twin beds adjacent to Full Bath.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
